decision: Adopt source-confirmed no real-member appearance for this exact upload only.

primaryStatement.speaker: Zoa
primaryStatement.question: What was your favorite part about filming the music video?
primaryStatement.quote: The “Stranger” music video is the first music video of ours that we don’t appear in.
primaryStatement.exactVersionBinding: The same article explicitly links Korean to https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9qRmlYPJB10 and English to FY9PFBxxKR8; anchor extraction saved separately.

corroboration.basis: A separate direct interview attributes to Zoa that members did not appear and the video was entirely animated. This is source corroboration, not necessarily an independent production investigation.
Licensed release catalog describes the first animated MV and lists both Korean and English tracks/videos; supports format, not independently exhaustive absence.

versionRisk: Interview discusses both language versions. Exact Korean anchor plus official watch metadata binds the target; no blanket rule applied to English uploads, remixes, stages, or later re-edits. Neither identical duration nor animation title alone is treated as absence proof.
